verdict.rationale: Alma's own pages say every case is attorney-led and that the firm combines expert attorneys with a 'technology-enabled system' and 'case intelligence', but no page states how AI is used in petition drafting or review, what is automated, or what a human attorney checks. Generic attorney-led and technology messaging is adjacent to the story and does not amount to an AI-use disclosure, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the provider states how it uses AI in petition drafting and review — what is automated, what a human attorney checks — on its own pages
